lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I have a question.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: How do you define beauty?
What makes you ask?

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Cinderella is beautiful,

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: as are you.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I think

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: anyone who shines bright is beautiful.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Cinderella's opinion differs from mine, though.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: What she considers beautiful are people who are close to her.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Anyone who refuses to give up and fights for their right to live.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: She even considers me beautiful.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I feel like there's a kind of beauty out there which I don't fully understand.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: That's why I asked you that question.
I think everyone defines beauty differently.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: You're right.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I knew that.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: That doesn't satisfy my curiosity, however.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I want to understand beauty as Cinderella sees it.
Wouldn't asking Cinderella solve this quickly?

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I did ask her.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: She said her appreciation of beauty is the same as I see it.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I don't follow.
You're overthinking this. Keep it simple.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: What do you mean?
She's talking about how wonderful a friendship between two people who trust and respect one another is.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Trust, respect...

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: A wonderful friendship...

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: When you say it out loud like that, I think I get it.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Isn't that like the relationship you and I have?
Exactly.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I see!

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: It is a beautiful relationship indeed.
I think anything that is able to survive and thrive in such an inhospitable environment like the surface is a beautiful thing.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Thriving?

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: On the surface?

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: It's a hard concept to grasp.
But that's precisely what you and Cinderella have done.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: We spent all those long years up on the surface,

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: and survived.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: We have an inexhaustible strength.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Even in the times where we felt desperate and miserable,

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Cinderella remained as beautiful as ever.
Perhaps that's why she feels you're so beautiful as well.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: But I'm broken.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I've fixed myself up quite a bit,

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: but I'm still far from beautiful.
Would you stop thinking Cinderella was beautiful if she changed physically?

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Appearance doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Cinderella will always be beautiful, no matter what.
Precisely, and the same applies to you.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I see!

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I think I understand now.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I understand what it was about me that Cinderella found beautiful,

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: and why she always calls me beautiful when she's looking at me.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Thank you, Superhuman.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I think I've found the answer to my question.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Thank you,

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: truly.
I ought to be the one thanking you for calling me beautiful.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: You are beautiful.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Don't ever lose that light which burns inside you.
I won't. I'll never lose it.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I believe you.
